questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Bacteria have varied roles and must be understood in their context.
options: Bacteria have varied roles and must be understood in their context.
All bacteria are harmful to humans.
Every bacterium performs the same function.
Removing all bacteria would always improve an ecosystem.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Bacteria have varied roles and must be understood in their context.

source.en: Viewing bacteria as members of changing ecological communities therefore encourages a more careful understanding of their roles, without assuming that every association has a single simple explanation.
